evals.prompt: Ponder the architecture of src/auth and keep thinking until it converges.
evals.expected_output: A converged multi-pass review report and ordered apply plan backed by a reconciled .ponder session ledger with 1.00 unit coverage.
expectations: The skill starts or resumes a session with scripts/ponder and enumerates every file in scope into units.json
Each pass records all four perspectives (skeptic, builder, dreamer, empath) and applies deltas with explicit why rationales
The skill refuses to stop while coverage is below 1.00 or while findings are still churning
The skill runs scripts/ponder verify and scripts/ponder report before presenting the final report

evals.prompt: Audit and grade every screen in our UI without skipping the back half.
evals.expected_output: An exhaustive UI review where every screen unit is explicitly scored on the UI lens dimensions before the session is allowed to stop.
expectations: The skill selects --lens ui and registers every screen unit in units.json
If any unit is left ungraded, scripts/ponder judge reports blocked and scripts/ponder decide stop exits 2
Once all units are graded and subsequent passes converge, the skill generates a ranked report

evals.prompt: Run a multi-pass code review that retracts weak claims on pass 2 instead of inventing nitpicks.
evals.expected_output: A multi-pass ledger where unsupported pass-1 findings are retracted via delete deltas and the session stops cleanly once two consecutive passes produce zero churn.
expectations: Pass 2 uses delete deltas with a written why when the skeptic perspective disproves a pass-1 claim
Pass 2 and later do not invent cosmetic deltas solely to appear active
scripts/ponder verify confirms that units.json and findings.json match the append-only ledger
